at.description: ISO-8601 BF event-occurrence time (same value as the BF journal entry `at`).

code.description: Machine-readable rejection code. Instrument-resolution codes: `instrument_unresolvable` (no broker symbol in the binding or target.instrument.broker_symbol, or the broker does not know it), `instrument_mismatch` (the broker asset behind broker_symbol disagrees with the deal's exchange/board/ticker), `instrument_delisted` (the instrument was delisted/archived at the broker), `unsupported` (the BF/connector cannot execute this deal, e.g. an unsupported mode/market).
